back_translation: Show the canvas in full, fitted to the window.
old_candidate_disposition: Not accepted; superseded by this exact replacement in the bounded translation review.
decision_scope: One translation-precision hold only. Not implementation approval or an app-release decision.
reason: Technical canvas vocabulary resolves the old canvas-versus-viewport noun gap. The fit-to-window relation combined with entirety and the show imperative supplies the missing display-fitting meaning. No specific remaining grammatical or semantic defect warrants retaining that hold.

component_findings.finding: The technical canvas head noun plus productive definite and direct-object morphology is adequate in a painting app. The glossary vector example is lexical support, not an imported object model.
The canvas is shown in its entirety. This does not exclude outlying editing bounds or mean Full screen mode.
An attested display-fitting relation. Its transfer from desktop window to editor viewport is independently accepted at medium confidence, not inherited from the short Fit review.
A software-attested show imperative. Its object-before-verb composition is grammatical and display-facing, not a request to modify document dimensions.

whole_caption_judgment.window_to_viewport_transfer: Accepted as contextual software usage. Canvas is the displayed object; window is the display target. The combined caption supports fitting into view without claiming stretching, edge-to-edge filling or application-window resizing.
whole_caption_judgment.exact_full_phrase_attestation: Not found and not required; the accepted caption is a new supported composition.
whole_caption_judgment.short_fit_prior_acceptance: Consistency context only; not authority for the long-caption decision.

source_behavior.role: Long accessibility description; also icon tooltip/help text on the vertical status path. The visible horizontal Fit caption is a different resource.
source_behavior.fit_target: Union of entire bitmap canvas, trim rectangle and rotated floating-selection bounds.
source_behavior.operation: Uniform viewport zoom and centering with padding, plus fit-state and polygon-tap bookkeeping. A too-small viewport can return early.
not_operation: Destructive resizing or cropping of the editable document
Fitting selection geometry into the canvas
source_behavior.resampling_qualification: Display-only overview downsampling may occur. Do not claim no resampling anywhere.
source_behavior.future_source_change: Correct canonical English first, flag affected language terms, and review them individually rather than change only this translation.

alternatives: No alternate proposed wording is accepted by this decision.
